title: The Fortress Territory Encirclement
statement:
You are given an N x M matrix board containing 'X' and 'O'.
Capture all regions that are 4-directionally surrounded by 'X'.
A region is captured by flipping all 'O's into 'X's in that surrounded region.
An 'O' is not surrounded if it is on the border of the board or connected to an 'O' on the border.
inputFormat:
First line: Two integers N and M.
Next N lines: M space-separated characters ('X' or 'O').
outputFormat: Print the modified N x M matrix, each row on a new line with space-separated characters.

sampleCases.input:
4 4
X X X X
X O O X
X X O X
X O X X
sampleCases.expectedOutput:
X X X X
X X X X
X X X X
X O X X
sampleCases.explanation: Internal O-cells are captured; border O at (3,1) is preserved.
